# Berat Doğan

> Software engineering student at Fırat University (expected graduation: 2027) and DevOps Engineer Intern at Soliner. Hands-on work with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud deployments on Azure and AWS.

## Background

- Fırat University — B.S. Software Engineering, expected 2027, Elazığ, Türkiye.
- Erasmus+ exchange in Computer Science at the University of Maribor, Slovenia (Feb–Jul 2025).
- Soliner — DevOps Engineer Intern (Jul 2026–present). Containerization and Kubernetes configurations in a BSS environment; reusable Helm charts, lab-based Istio routing, and monitoring for an AKS internship project.
- Turkish (native), English (B2).

## Projects

- Cloud Native Order Platform — Soliner internship project, 2026. Terraform-managed AKS, Node.js and PostgreSQL deployed with Helm. GitHub Actions tests, Helm validation and Trivy scanning; OIDC publishing to ACR and Argo CD synchronization. Key Vault with External Secrets Operator and Workload Identity; NetworkPolicies and Istio-based canary delivery with Argo Rollouts. HPA and recommendation-only VPA; Velero CSI snapshots with restored PostgreSQL data files verified in a separate namespace. Repository: https://github.com/BeratDgan/cloud-native-order-platform
- Trackruit — job application tracking app with Next.js and Supabase. Docker images deployed via ECR to AWS ECS Fargate, with ALB, ACM HTTPS and Cloudflare DNS. GitHub Actions automates builds and deployments; IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and SNS/EventBridge support the setup.
- PrePath — academic technical interview project (2024–2025). Technical team lead and Scrum Master for four people. Dockerized RAG backend, 40,000+ records indexed in Qdrant, and LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning.
- Lyricly.tech — Spotify API web app; backend and OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.
- Live Streaming Platform — Node.js and Socket.io broadcast backend.
